intent: Teach early landing against schedule, helicopter supplies to island, gentle boat motion by steps, ship overnight in harbour, ferry across river with walkers, front-wheel air need, tyre versus metal rim and each-brake-before-downhill instruction.
picturePurpose: Original tyre/rim comparison identifies rubber component without invented damage. Five changing relation models, exact supplies evidence and a quantifier-preserving order teach time, direction, place, degree and unmet need.

transfer.stem: 换成长途客车、骑车人和车灯，哪组三句完整保留了意思？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
我们的长途客车提前到达了。渡船把骑车人送到湖对岸。骑车回家前检查每盏车灯。
词语提示：coach 长途客车；cyclist 骑车人；light 车灯。

options.text: Our coach arrived behind schedule. The ferry takes cyclists across the lake. Test each light before riding home.
Our coach arrived ahead of schedule. The ferry takes cyclists across the lake. Test each light before riding home.
Our coach arrived ahead of schedule. The ferry takes cyclists along the lake. Test each light before riding home.
Our coach arrived ahead of schedule. The ferry takes cyclists across the lake. Test just one light after riding home.

answer.display: Our coach arrived ahead of schedule. The ferry takes cyclists across the lake. Test each light before riding home.

explanation.strategy: 核对相对计划的先后、横渡方向与每个/之前两个要求。

steps.text: 长途客车提前到达：arrived ahead of schedule。
steps.reason: behind schedule晚于计划，与提前相反。

steps.text: 渡船把骑车人送到湖对岸：takes cyclists across the lake。
steps.reason: along the lake沿湖改变了across横渡。

steps.text: 骑车回家前检查每盏车灯：Test each light before riding home。

distractors.reason: just one与after分别改变每盏和回家前。

explanation.pitfall: ahead of schedule不是behind；across不是along；each与before都要保留。

visual.title: 提前、横渡、逐个在先
visual.caption: 不补具体分钟或人数，不漏每个和之前。

explanation.transfer: 把each换成one、before换成after，哪两项要求改变了？
